The calendar year result was also significantly impacted by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years of $48.5m. $26.6m of this claims development affected the Non-Marine Liability class, $13.2m from Property D&F and $4.9m from Specie & Cargo.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Heavily impacted the 2016 year of account, contributing to losses and reserve strengthening primarily in Property classes and reducing available reinstatements on reinsurance.
Contributed materially to losses on the 2016 year affecting Property classes and reducing recoveries due to exhausted reinstatements.
Part of the 2016 calendar year catastrophes that increased claims and reserves in Property D&F.
Affected International Property Treaty portfolio contributing to adverse development in the 2016 account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Large liability losses (Non-Marine Liability open market & US)
prior_year_events.impact_description: A number of individual large losses in US and International Open Market sub-classes produced adverse development and led to strengthening of reserves for 2015/2016 periods.

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Florence and Michael; Typhoons Jebi and Trami; Californian wildfires (group)
named_events.loss_description: The total net cost of these five events for the 2018 calendar year to the Syndicate is $21.7m; within risk appetite for events of this type and frequency.
Noted as materially affecting the syndicate, particularly Property D&F and Property Binders classes, and contributing to the 2016 year loss on closure.
Significantly affected the syndicate's Property D&F and Property Binders portfolios and reduced available reinstatements.
Affected the International Property Treaty portfolio.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding was $377.3m. During 2018 there was material adverse prioryear development: using the gross claims development table the portfolio shows approximately $80.1m of deterioration on underwriting years 2016 and earlier (21.2% of opening reserves). The strengthening was driven by adverse development in Casualty (NonMarine Liability) and Property (Property D&F and Treaty exposures), driven by a mix of large liability losses, natural catastrophe losses (notably 2016/2017 catastrophes) and increased IBNR/recalibration of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years of $48.5m.
$26.6m of this claims development affected the Non-Marine Liability class, $13.2m from Property D&F and $4.9m from Specie & Cargo.

Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $215,601,000 (2017: $225,755,000) is a deterioration of $48,466,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2017: deterioration $5,582,000).
reserves for claims incurred but not reported for the 2016, 2017 and 2018 years have also been strengthened.

the Property D&F class was further impacted by flooding and hail events in Texas and Louisiana, as well as under-performing risks in the habitational class that had higher than expected levels of attritional claims.
The 2016 year of account has been heavily impacted by the 2017 third quarter catastrophe losses, notably hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's native currency (USD) and expressed in millions despite field names containing 'gbp_m'. Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures) because no single gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line with a gross figure was provided; narrative and note statements quoting $48.5m / $48,466k refer to deterioration described in the net calendar year claims context and therefore appear to be net measures. The triangle-derived gross PYD (~$80.1m) differs from the narrative/net deterioration (~$48.5m); users should note this distinction (gross vs net of reinsurance) when reconciling. Confidence levels reflect whether figures are direct lineitems (1.0), calculated from published tables (0.8) or inferred/allocated from narrative (0.5-0.7).
